svg.title: coderprint: 660k lines of code in use, of 874k written, all time
svg.desc: 659,769 lines of code in use (453,407 in production, 206,362 in tests), of 873,976 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 2,819 commits across all branches, 52 active days, a longest streak of 37 days, a current streak of 37 days, and 5 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 799k lines of code. The bars end on 14OCT2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 41%, Lean 31%, Python 14%, TypeScript 9%, JavaScript 4%, other languages under 1%. Of what was written, 75% is kept.
